text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Survival of the fittest. The act of eating is nothing less than a battle where lives are wagered upon one another—
Leave an opening in your heart, and you will be defeated at once, ending up on the victor’s table.
Such is the one absolute law of the purgatorial lands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
弱肉強食。
食の営みとは即ち、
互いの命を賭した戦いに他ならず──
心に隙あらば忽ち敗れ、
勝者の食卓に上ることとなり申す。
これぞ煉獄の地に於ける、
唯一絶対の法にありけり。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Even a fish upon the cutting board must not be underestimated.
Look away for but a moment, and it may bare its fangs.
Eat this dish, and you will learn its meaning whether you wish to or not…
text_block_list.orig_text:
俎板の上の魚と云えど
油断は禁物。
目を反らせば、
途端に牙を剥くやもしれませぬ。
此方の料理を食せば、
其の意味を
否が応にも知らされましょう……
